english.title: Prohibited person take part in / concerned in the promotion / formation / management of a company
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[being an undischarged bankrupt,]_
(B)_[being subject to a bankruptcy restrictions order or undertaking,]_
(C)_[being subject to a debt relief restrictions order or undertaking,]_
(D)_[when a moratorium period under a debt relief order applied,]_

took part in or were concerned in the promotion, formation or management of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY THE COMPANY..), without the leave of the court
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 11(1), (2) and 13 of the Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being an undischarged bankrupt OR
being subject to a bankruptcy restrictions order or undertaking OR
being subject to a debt relief restrictions order or undertaking OR
when a moratorium period under a debt relief order applied
took part / concerned in the promotion / formation / management
of a company without leave of the court

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
